description: Send a private message in an item, Support or Wanted conversation. Use it for discussion; use offer or respond for binding negotiations, and contact for new SIBIDZ Support requests. An accepted item message costs 6 SBZ; Support and Wanted replies are free. Recipients may receive notifications. Supply the exact thread, message, request_id and approved max_fee. Retry identical arguments with the same request_id after uncertainty. It returns the message receipt, current thread state and billing.

conversation_id.description: Existing private conversation identity; do not invent a new thread. UUID.

expected_revision.description: Exact revision last read; stale edits are refused.

lot_id.description: Stable listing UUID; it is distinct from a sale publication.

max_fee.description: Approved immediate service fee ceiling as a whole SBZ string; separate from the item price.

message.description: Private message text; this never creates trading authority.

request_id.description: UUID for one logical request; reuse it with identical arguments after uncertainty. UUID.

saleId.description: Exact sale identity returned by discovery or the conversation.

share_token.description: Unguessable token from the exact secret share link. It grants viewing only; normal account, participation and trading requirements still apply.

thread_kind.description: Choose the item, Support or Wanted conversation owner. support: private free SIBIDZ help; wanted: your saved wanted conversations.

name: reply

billing.description: charged, assessed, balance and available_credits are whole SBZ strings or null; receipt_id identifies the saved fee. Replays never charge twice.

committed_stages.description: Stages already committed before a later refusal; retain their receipts.

data.description: Accepted message identity, conversation and replay receipt. IDs are exact returned identifiers (UUID where declared); prices retain amount/currency (123 USD); times use ISO 8601 UTC; cursors are opaque.

error.description: Optional business error: code, message, HTTP status, retryable and recovery details.

next.description: Exactly one required continuation: call, input, approval, choice, wait or done. It never grants new consent.

pagination.description: Optional next-page call; not required work or consent.

retry.description: Optional exact request_id and permitted recovery call.

state.description: Outcome: finished, still processing, needs approval/input, or refused.

summary.description: Plain-language result, including a business error.

title: Send a private message
